goal: Introduce a new helper class to hold TokeniserState's static helper methods and related constants/arrays so the enum can be reduced in size and complexity.

ops.details: Create a new class org.jsoup.parser.TokeniserStateHelpers with the following static members copied from TokeniserState: nullChar, attributeNameCharsSorted, attributeValueUnquoted, replacementChar, replacementStr, eof, and the private static methods handleDataEndTag, readRawData, readCharRef, readEndTag, handleDataDoubleEscapeTag, readDoctypeInternalSubset. Place the new class in the same package (org.jsoup.parser). The implementations are identical copies so the project compiles after adding the helper class.
